info.title: AttOs HoYo Dashboard Web Session API
info.summary: Manual contract for the Dioxus Dashboard UI, the cookie-authenticated web session API, and per-user API tokens.
info.description:
This contract documents the implemented Dashboard routes. Browsers use the cookie-authenticated web session. External clients may use a per-user bearer API token (`ahdApiToken`) on the operations that list it; every other operation is session-only. No OAuth is provided. The Dioxus build may serve hashed files under /assets as browser-internal static assets, but those generated filenames are not stable API operations.

HoYoLAB integration and manual/scheduled rewards are normal features when Cookie storage encryption is configured and password/verified-Cookie setup is complete. Automatic rewards default OFF and require user opt-in. Availability does not establish live upstream token-to-UID binding or the reward period/POST reflection contract.

put.summary: Change current user's password and rotate the session secret without extending expiry.
put.description: Authenticated mandatory first/reissued password setup may omit current_password. Ordinary changes require the correct current_password; an explicitly supplied incorrect value is always rejected. The new password must differ from the stored password even when current_password is omitted. Confirmation is checked by the client, not sent to this endpoint. The business layer reauthenticates the session and validates account freshness under the user lock, revokes all existing sessions, and issues a replacement with the same login deadline.

attosSessionCookie.name: __Host-attos_session
attosSessionCookie.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session cookie. HTTPS deployments use __Host-attos_session with Secure; localhost HTTP uses attos_session.

ahdApiToken.description: Per-user API token (`ahd_` + 64 hex digits) issued from the security settings. Scope `read` reaches only the operations that list it; scope `run` also queues a manual reward run. Bearer requests without a Cookie header need no Origin; a request carrying both a token and the session cookie is rejected.

message.description: Sanitized static or numeric diagnostic; never includes secrets or raw upstream messages.

last_login_at.description: Last successful password or passkey sign-in.

verification_available.description: True when Cookie storage encryption is configured. Saving a Cookie alone does not complete verification; identity and roles checks are still required.

reward_posting_available.description: True when Cookie storage encryption is configured. Reward access still requires completed password setup, a verified link, and authorization; automatic rewards default OFF.

timezone_offset.description: UTC offset of the schedule clock now.

timezone.description: IANA zone name when TIMEZONE is set; null for a fixed TIMEZONE_OFFSET.

current_password.description: Required for ordinary password changes. May be omitted or null only for a fresh authenticated account with must_change_password=true (first/reissued setup). If supplied, must be correct.

confirmation.description: Exact target username typed by the actor.

WebAuthnOptions.description: Opaque WebAuthn options object returned by webauthn-rs. The browser-facing UI converts base64url fields before calling navigator.credentials.

WebAuthnCredentialResponse.description: Browser PublicKeyCredential JSON wrapper as produced by the Dioxus web-sys/js-sys WebAuthn bridge; fields are intentionally not hand-expanded.

last_used_at.description: Last successful sign-in with this passkey.

cookie.description: Raw HoYoLAB Cookie header; never returned.

avatar_side_icon.description: Genshin expedition avatar icon, when provided upstream.

item_url.description: Star Rail assignment item icon, when provided upstream.

transformer_ready.description: Genshin Parametric Transformer is ready to use.

transformer_ready_at.description: Projected from the transformer recovery time when not yet ready.

total_sign_day.description: Rewards claimed this month, from the last check-in status.

anyOf.description: Today's check-in reward: the next one when unclaimed, otherwise the one claimed.

last_seen_at.description: Updated at most every five minutes.

UserChangeInput.description: Exactly one change: activation or the administrator role. Administrators cannot change their own role or disable themselves.

NotificationEvents.description: Event names → whether to notify. Unknown keys are rejected.

webhook_hint.description: Short, non-secret description of the stored URL.

push_public_key.description: VAPID public key (base64url, uncompressed P-256) when the server supports push.

webhook_url.description: Absent keeps the stored URL, null removes it, a string replaces it.

app.description: Whether the notice was queued for the user's app installations.

p256dh.description: base64url uncompressed P-256 public key (65 bytes decoded).

cursor.description: Read inbox entries after this id.

kind.description: A personal notification event, or test.

tag.description: Deduplication key; a newer notice with the same tag replaces the older one.

url.description: Dashboard path of the screen that handles the notice, e.g. /settings/bonus.

cursor.description: Pass as after on the next read.

EventList.description: Known kinds — personal: reward_failed, reward_claimed, cookie_invalid, signed_in, sign_in_failed, resource_near_cap, resource_full, expeditions_done, transformer_ready, daily_unfinished, weekly_unfinished. Admin: user_attention, worker_stalled, deletion_stuck, sign_in_failed, signed_in.

last_used_at.description: Updated at most every five minutes.
Updated at most every five minutes.

token.description: The plaintext token. Returned only by this response; only its hash is stored.

name.description: Trimmed; 1 to 100 characters without control characters.

scope.description: `read`: dashboard data reads. `run`: reads plus the manual reward run.
